children: People Inc reported $1.83 billion in total 2025 revenue and operating income of $63.9 million, after selling Care.com for $300.2 million and recording a $207.5 million goodwill impairment at Care.com.
Completed sale of Care.com for $300.2M (plus $4.5M received July 2026); Care.com presented as discontinued operations.
Total 2025 revenue $1.833B, down 2% vs 2024; Digital +7% to $1.162B, Print down 13% to $622.3M.
Operating income improved to $63.9M in 2025 from a $75.1M loss in 2024, driven by lower amortization and stock-based comp and $45M net gains on lease/asset actions.
Recorded $207.5M goodwill impairment for Care.com in Q4 2025; aggregate Care.com goodwill carrying value noted among at-risk amounts.
Holds 65.8M MGM shares (~25.5%); unrealized pre-tax gain on MGM of $119.2M in 2025 and fair value of investment was $2.2B at Feb 2, 2026.
